XII.

nio. Et, nullo tamen ægrotantium damno, in varias
itum est sententias.
XIII.

XIV.
De cuius tamen artificiosa constructione, &c.,
quam eiusdem meretur dignitas, ac in immensum dif-
fusa utilitas postulat, Methodo, non apud omnes
aequaliter constat.
XV.
Hippocratem, tantum heroem, eadem haec quoque;
latuisse, adeoque optasse magis, quam praestitisse videos.
XVI.
Unde vero hanc eximiam medendi artem omnium
tutissime rectissimeque comparare queamus, varias o-
piniones, adeoque Sectas Medicorum conspiciuntur.

page.notes: The catchword "iunctis-" at the bottom right is partly unclear; it may read "iuncti-" [?]. The numeral "XIIX" is printed that way (for XVIII) and is kept as printed. The signature "D 3" is read from a small mark and may be "D iij" [?]. The Greek-like symbols after "Arte" are not clearly legible and are omitted. "ARTEM" is set in small capitals as printed. The line "varias itum" is printed with a break, and no hyphen is shown there.
